newsitem.title: USA: W.R. Grace to sell Amicon unit to Millipore.
newsitem.headline: W.R. Grace to sell Amicon unit to Millipore.

text.p: Millipore Corp said on Monday that it agreed to acquire the net assets of W.R. Grace & Co's Amicon Separation Sciences business for $125 million in cash.
Millipore expected the acquisition to be accretive to earnings by mid-1997. The deal was expected to be completed within 60 days, it said.

Amicon makes protein purification tools for research laboratory and for biotechnology manufacturing, the company said. It had about $60 million in revenues in fiscal 1995 and manufacturing operations in the United States and Europe, W.R. Grace said.

Millipore Chairman and Chief Executive Officer C. William Zadel said the acquisition would strengthen the protein pipeline, or the process of discovering, developing, scaling up and manufacturing new therapeutics.
"This is one of Millipore's best opportunities for growth over the next 10 years," he said.
